profile.headline: BIOS MRC Software Engineer at Intel Corporation
profile.summary:
Engineer motivated for discovering new technology, continuous improvement, professional growth and building a better world.

Currently, Software Developer working with Bios computer firmware. Providing support to debug issues, feature development and bug fixes.

Autimotive Software Engineer Senior Staff with 3+ years experience performing as Software Program Manager in charge of delivering and meeting the goals with the best quality to customers in automotive industry.

Electronics and Computers Engineer with 12+ years of experience working among different disciplines such as Bios SW development, Post-Silicon Digital and Analog Validation, Hardware Validation, R&D Electronics and Embedded Systems.

General knowldege:
- Electronic Design for Power, Analog and Digital circuits.
- Programming “C/C++” language for PC and Embedded Systems.
- Programming Assambler language for Embedded Systems.
- Programming Python scripting language.
- Programming Delphi, Pascal and Visual Basic for Applications in MS Excel.
- Verilog, VHDL and System Verilog description language.
- NXP, AVR, PIC Microcontroller and 8031, Intel Microprocessor Architecture.
- Lauterbach debug tool.
- Automotive Software Vector Software Stack and CAN Bus simulation tools.
- Software Integration and Control Versioning tools.
- Linux, DOS and Windows environments general user.

positions.title: BIOS MRC Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop BIOS, reference code and related documentation
for Intel silicon products such as next generation chipsets and processors.

positions.title: Software Engineer Senior Staff at Continental
Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible of developing Automotive Software for embedded systems.

Member of stability team providing debug and support to critical issues in projects around the world.

Performing as a Software Program Manager in charge of planning/administrating/analyzing schedules and resources to meet the project milestones.

positions.title: BIOS Developer
positions.description: Responsible of developing BIOS Memory Reference Code (MRC) for hardware memory interface.

positions.title: Hardware Engineer
positions.description: Responsible of validating new technologies at Pre-SIlicon and Post-Silicon environments, in charge of developing software automation infrastructure (Python, bash, etc.), in charge of reporting progress indicators and dashboards at different forums also leading planning and validation pace.

positions.title: Research Development Electronic Engineer
positions.description: Responsible of R&D for electronic hardware and embedded systems, responsible of designing and presenting entire solution to customers. Responsible of developing plug-ins for printers and paper handlers for different brands such as HP. Ricoh, Xerox, etc.

publications.title: SMV METHODOLOGY ENHACEMENTS FOR HIGH SPEED I/O LINKS OF SoCs
